content:
Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by some of the best AirPods deals of the year – AirPods Pro 3 down at $199, AirPods 4 nearly 25% off, and the best price ever on AirPods Max 2. Alongside the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 down at $299 ($100 off) and Apple Watch SE 3 down at $219, we also have a super rare discount hitting Apple’s latest black Ultra Trail Loop today and Spigen’s Athlex Trail Loop-style Apple Watch band at $20. Just be sure to also scope out these M5 MacBook Air models still up to $270 off. Head below for a closer look.

Early Amazon Prime Day deals now live: AirPods Pro 3, Pixel 10, Ring smart home up to 50% off, more

Some of the best AirPods deals of the year are live this week

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 $499 (Reg. $549)

Apple’s new AirPods Max 2 hit best price ever (New Amazon all-time low)

Most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 now down at $299 (Amazon low at $100 off)

While we are already tracking AirPods Pro 3 back down at one of the lowest prices to date and AirPods 4 at $99 again, Amazon has just brought back its all-time low pricing on the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 at $100 off.

Amazon is now offering the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 at $299 shipped.

This is a regularly $399 configuration and the most affordable Series 11 you can buy. Now $100 off the list price, this is matching the lowest price we have ever tracked at Amazon or anywhere else outside of YMMV and in-store offers on the least expensive model there is.

As of the time of writing, only the Jet Black, Silver, and Rose Gold models are down this low. We will keep an eye out for the Space Gray.

There are some discounts live on the larger 46mm case size, but we recommend waiting until you see the model you’re after at a clean $100 off the list price. Right now the best deals have them at $70 off and we have seen them at $100 off plenty of times – this deal will almost certainly return by month’s end, if not much sooner.

Stock is extremely low, but you will find Series 11 at up to $160 off via Amazon Resale in Used – Like New condition right now as well. Details on the best of those offers awaits right here.

Super rare discount hits Apple’s latest black Ultra Trail Loop today

Official Apple Watch band sale: Originally $99 Alpine/Trail Loops from $35, Sport models from $15 (65% off)

Score a current-gen Apple Watch SE 3 with always on display down at $219 this week

Apple’s mid-range M5 iPad Pro models back to some of the best prices yet at nearly $150 off

Update 4/5: These mid-range M5 iPad Pro deals are now live once again at $150 off.

After spotting a new Amazon all-time low on the 1TB 11-inch M5 iPad Pro with the nano-texture glass upgrade down at $1,499 shipped, Amazon has also now brought back one of the best prices to date on the more accessible mid-range 13-inch 512GB model at nearly $150 off.

Amazon is now offering the 512GB 13-inch M5 iPad Pro down at $1,349.99 shipped in both the Space Black and Silver colorways.

Regularly $1,499, this is just shy of $150 off the list prices and the best we can find in brand new condition. Today’s deal lands on par with the lowest we have tracked on Amazon for the Silver variant and within a few bucks of the best on the Space Black – it dropped to $1,344 for a very brief stint once.

You will also find the somewhat mid-range 11-inch 1TB model back down in the $150 off range at Amazon as well.

While we do see the more pricey models with $200 price drops from time to time – like the aforementioned 1TB model, the more accessible mid-range variants are rarely sold for any better than $100 and $150 off.

Deal pricing going up on M5 MacBook Air this week, but these 15-inch models are still up to $270 off

Spigen’s Athlex Trail Loop-style Apple Watch band starts at $20 right now (All colors)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Logitech’s Keys-to-Go 2 Wireless keyboard with built-in cover for portable iPad setup just fell to $60 (2026 low)
  • Tested: ORICO’s folder-shaped SSD brings some personality and performance at a solid price [Deal]
  • This 100W 20,000mAh 4-port USB-C power bank is less than an inch thick, and it’s 56% off now at $39.50 low
  • Originally $300 Bose QuietComfort ANC Earbuds II now at $149 Amazon all-time low
  • Skip smart plugs and grab Tapo’s Matter-certified in-wall outlet with energy monitoring for $22 instead
  • Get up close with feathered visitors via Birdfy’s Smart Bird Feeder with camera or solar bundle starting from a $100 low
  • Bag a spare USB-C Apple Watch charging cable for only $12.50 Prime shipped

Score a 4-pack of AirTags today from $12.50 each, AirTag 2 from $25

While we are yet to track any particularly notable deals on the new AirTag 2 just yet, Woot has been serving up some particularly notable deals on the AirTag 4-pack lately and today it is giving folks another shot at one of the better prices we have tracked – four for $53.99 or less. Details below.

Woot is currently offering Apple’s 4-pack of AirTags own at $59.99 Prime shipped. But if you checkout with the Woot app, the price will drop another 10% to $53.99 Prime shipped, or $13.50 per AirTag.

And if you’re a first-time Woot customer, checking out in the app will knock 15% off to bring your total down to $50.99, or $12.74 per AirTag.

This is within a couple bucks of the lowest price we have tracked per AirTag and a great chance to grab a bundle of them at a discount.

Apple’s new AirTag 2 did release this year at the same price as the original model we have here today. There are certainly has some upgraded features on the next-gen variant, but the previous model at a price like this is still a notable option for adding some simple tracking action to just about anything you can think of at less than half the price right now:

  • AirTag 2 $29
  • Or open-box at $25
  • AirTag 2 – 4-pack $99

Official Apple accessory deals from $7.50: Black USB-C and extra MacBook MagSafe 3 cables, more

All brand new condition iPhone Air models just dropped back to all-time low pricing at $149 off

iPhone Air is $149 off today, and its official MagSafe Battery is at $59 (40% off, all-time low)

Apple’s least expensive current-gen iPad is down at $299 today (All colors)

If you’re looking for an affordable Apple iPad experience without having to score an older model or something refurbished, perhaps the best model for younger kids or something the whole family can pass around, the current iPad 11 is a solid option. And now all four colors are back down at the 2026 Amazon low at $299 shipped.

Amazon is now offering the 11-inch iPad (A16) down at $299 shipped. This includes the Blue, Silver, Pink, and Yellow models.

  • iPad (A16) from $299 (Reg. $349)

Regularly $249 straight from Apple, we have tracked a number of opportunities to land this model down at a price like this in 2026, and now you’re getting another shot at any color you want for the lowest it has been offered this year.

There were a few chances to score one for a bit less over the holidays last year, but with it already carrying a relatively light MSRP (at least as far as Apple gear goes), deal pricing never really gets all that aggressive. We might see these iPad models drop into the $275 range at some point this year, but those deals are hard to come by and rarely stick around for very long – it also tends to only drop that low on select colors.

Today’s iPad 11 deal joins a few notable early Prime Apple deals, including AirPods Pro 3 at one of the lowest prices to date and AirPods 4 at $99, but you’ll find even more of them waiting below:
